raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: falcon-apispec
  version: 0.4.0

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3be2d7a544852fb6ec78bcdd27f28cb62418337ab85ab23685632f7946f667e5

build:
  number: 1
  noarch: python
  script: python -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - pip
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - apispec >=1.0
    - falcon
    - pyyaml >=3.10

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - falcon_apispec
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: apispec plugin that generates OpenAPI specification (aka Swagger) for Falcon web applications
  homepage: https://github.com/alysivji/falcon-apispec
  repository: https://github.com/alysivji/falcon-apispec

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - synapticarbors
